report: Checked all 24 candidate lemmas end to end. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own text: the Sp1cs suffixes left unrepresented are the lexicalized suffix of אֲדֹנָי (rule 57, PSA.86.3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 15) and the suffix inside the fused לְבַדֶּךָ → alone (rule 30, PSA.86.10); O Lord vs Lord, O thou vs thou, and O Jehovah vs Jehovah follow whether the ASV wrote the vocative O (rule 36); For/Because, That/and, unto/in/against/toward are the ASV's renderings of one morpheme.

The two unrepresented לְ (PSA.86.9 glorify thy name, PSA.86.16 save the son) are both rule 40 promotions of a dative object to a bare English object, the same construction analysed the same way; the two rendered לְ before a construct noun (PSA.86.5, 16 unto) each have a written word. חָנַן → Be merciful unto (86.3) and have mercy upon (86.16) both give the supplied preposition to the verb under rule 44, as do call upon (86.5, 86.7), Give ear unto (86.6) and sought after (86.14); no split.

Supplied words checked across the dump: the asyndetic and of 86.1, the italic works of 86.8 and the object it of 86.17 are the only added units, each answering to no morpheme; the phrasal particles down (86.1), up (86.4, 86.14) and the durative long (86.3) are kept with their hosts on rule 44/31 reasoning and each note names the added alternative. 86.8's 'any' on the existential (the residue of none once the negation fused into Neither) and 86.14's לְנֶגְדָּם head on נגד are defensible readings with the competing one recorded.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences, none an error: paragogic he ×5 (rule 32), the title suffix ×7 (rule 57), לִ/לְ before promoted objects in 86.9 and 86.16 (rule 40), עִמִּי in 86.17 where the ASV recasts 'do with me a sign' as 'Show me' (rule 40), and the suffix on לְבַד in 86.10 (rule 30).

The eight repeating notes flagged by the validator each restate a contract rule (15, 19, 20, 29, 32, 36, 57), so no convention is recorded; nothing in this chapter generalises beyond the contract as written.
